\section{What the analysis notices}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.4em]
  \item \finding{warning} Ranks 8, 14 appear in the log without participating; the declared world size is 8. Shared worker pools let a worker register against the wrong job, which inflates the apparent rank count.
  \item \finding{note} Load imbalance is 1.61$\times$: the slowest rank was busy far longer than the mean.
  \item \finding{ok} 23 rank reattachment(s) occurred, up to incarnation 4: agent processes were replaced mid-run while the rank roles, their mailboxes, and their context accounts persisted.
  \item \finding{ok} All 9 checkable collective(s) sent exactly the number of messages their closed-form cost expression predicts.
\end{itemize}
